a: The periodic table organizes elements by atomic number and properties.
Atomic number is the number of protons in the nucleus.
Isotopes have the same protons but different neutrons.
A catalyst speeds a reaction without being consumed.
Oxidation is loss of electrons; reduction is gain.
Acids donate protons; bases accept protons (Brønsted).
Molarity is moles of solute per liter of solution.
